concepts.label: Live Query
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - a query that stays active and re-runs automatically on database change, posting results to change listeners/Flows/LiveData; no equivalent construct in server/'s or Capella's request/response query model

cross_product_finding: No access-control, edition, or version gating on this page at all - Live Query is a client-side reactive-UI mechanism (change listener attached to a query statement, optionally surfaced via Kotlin Flow/LiveData) with no server-side or licensing dimension whatsoever. This is a useful negative data point: not every CBL feature maps onto the 'edition/version/access-control' axes this stress test is probing for; some pages are simply orthogonal to all of them.
